subject: Transportation Systems
title: Refrigerated Containers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Refrigerated Containers usable.

hook.text: Your winter strawberries from Chile survived a 6,000-mile ocean voyage in a refrigerated container.

buildup.text: Reefer containers maintain precise temperatures from -30°C to +30°C for weeks at sea.

discovery.text: They plug into the ship's electrical grid. A single vessel can power hundreds of reefers at once.

twist.text: If the power fails, a shipload of bananas is ruined within 48 hours. Monitoring is constant.

climax.text: Reefer technology globalized the food supply—any fruit, any season, from anywhere.

punchline.text: A cold box erased the seasons from grocery stores.

quiz.question: What is a reefer container?
options: A refrigerated container for perishable goods
